definition: a long table where business is done
description: An animated fried chicken shop at dusk. A grumpy ginger cat in a white chef's hat and a stained white apron stands behind the metal counter, with lit menu boards of fried chicken above and a deep fryer full of bubbling oil set into the counter in front of it. A pigeon stands on the counter arguing with the cat, which scowls back with narrowed green eyes. The pigeon then flaps wildly, tips over the edge and drops into the bubbling fryer. A single feather floats down and the cat stares at it open-mouthed.
transcript: One iced latte with oat milk. Ma'am, we only do fried chicken. No, sweetie. I said oat milk. The customer is always-- Fried pigeon, limited time.
